note: Set B states nearly all Table 7-1 sensitivities with the correct E+6 magnitude and the page's ∂P/∂θ symbol, giving about 13 faithful claims over 9 distinct rows plus the Eq. 7-16a linear model, whereas Set A truncates six values (-94.71, -43.73, -51.66E, -83.94E, -99.04E, -120.20E instead of the -xx.xxE+6 entries) and twice invents the symbol ∂P/∂β, which does not appear on the page. A does cover the 20.0, 24.0 and 25.0 m/s rows that B omits and adds the Eq. 7-16b inverse form, so its coverage is somewhat wider, but its wrong readings are three times as many. Both sets pad the results with trivial or misbound claims attaching bare wind-speed/rotor-speed/pitch values to a 'Baseline Blade-Pitch Controller' entity that is not named on the page (10 such claims each, counted as wrong in both), and B also duplicates several rows. On balance B is the more accurate and faithful extraction.
